purpose: Review MDB audio Sample Rate sources and numeric retention for Bella, using the installed Media Composer and MDVx binaries plus six real MDBs and paired PMRs.
status: Per-class concrete source, exact supported numeric retention, blank unavailable MDB values and no MDFL repair approved by the user on 20 October 2026. Not yet implemented. Audio-only Sample Rate in kHz and blank video Sample Rate remain agreed; OldScanner remains active and Bin Filter unchanged.

agreedBoundary.duration: Keep the independently approved own MDFL:Length / MDFL:SampleRate pair and scoped AvidDurationInterpreter. No header reads for Duration. This review does not change that source contract.
agreedBoundary.audioDisplayClock: An EditRate for HH:MM:SS:FF and qualified DF ownership remain separate requirements; audio Hz does not provide those facts.
agreedBoundary.newCode: No Bella runtime implementation in this review; requirements first, independent C++17 / Qt 6.5.3 code later, explicit approval before app cutover.

mediaComposer.method: Static read-only arm64 disassembly and manual reconstruction of descriptor read/write/getter routes. No private API execution or live UI scan.
mediaComposer.owner: Complete FileMobId -> qualified file catalogue owner -> its own MOBJ:PhysicalMedia descriptor.

PCMA.encoding: Signed32 numerator followed by signed32 denominator in object byte order.
PCMA.getters: AudioMediaDesc::GetAudioSamplingRate 0x360a54; PCMA GetRate 0x3e9428 and GetExactEditRate 0x3e9444 use concrete frequency. GetEditRate 0x3e9484 uses the base descriptor clock.
PCMA.missing: The observed Get stores the typed reader result unconditionally, with no local fallback to MDFL. Missing typed read yields zero.
PCMA.precision: Native typed reading can pass nondecimal denominators through floating point. Bella should retain the original exact pair.

AIFD.source: COMM payload sampleRate at offset 8, ten bytes, big-endian extended80.
read: ConvertFromIeeeExtended 0x36604c decodes the value. Native 0x365884..90 adds 0.5 and truncates to whole Hz.
SetRate at 0x3652a8..bc updates native descriptor clocks.
AIFD.write: PutMetaData 0x3663ac..e0 obtains the rate, calls ConvertToIeeeExtended at 0x3663c4 and writes ten bytes into Summary.
AIFD.precision: Native whole-Hz rounding is proven; exact supported retention is Bella design, not a native precision claim.

WAVD.source: Standard RIFF/WAVE fmt payload nSamplesPerSec at offset 4, unsigned LE32 integer Hz.
read: ReadWAVEMetaData 0x3f9b08 calls ReadFmtChunk; integer rate read at 0x3fa658..670.
Parsed integer Hz is supplied to SetRate at 0x3fa084..a4.
WAVD.write: PutMetaData 0x3f9680 delegates InitWaveStream; GetRate at 0x3f8da4..b0 and sample-rate write at 0x3f8e30..48.

mediaComposer.summaryOverridesBase: UAFDescriptor::SetRate 0x402760 updates base AFile rate and AudioSamplingRate. AIFD/WAVD concrete Summary decoding overwrites rates loaded earlier from MDFL.
mediaComposer.fallbackLimit: No guaranteed valid field-local fallback from missing/bad concrete frequency to MDFL was established. Residual base state after an error does not establish successful parsing.
mediaComposer.noPhysicalMediaRead: These frequency reads consume Summary bytes already embedded in MDB. They do not require a physical WAV/AIFF file open.
limits: Concrete descriptor read/write priority was traced, not all UI call paths.
Only the approved PCMA/AIFD/WAVD audio classes are reviewed.
No universal missing-Summary success or Get-failure contract was established.

mdvx.method: Fresh installed binary SHA256 and direct arm64 CFString decoding; re-read bounded previously captured exact-function disassembly for the identical binary. No new app launch, scan, export, private API execution or media read/write. Numeric examples are static predictions.
mdvx.sourceFunction: -[MDVxOMFI getCompression_data:forObjAt:] 0x100064b60, matched file own descriptor. Existing identity lookup uses eight-byte excerpts, unlike Bella.
sourcePriority: Presence of PCMA:AudioSamplingRate selects that payload; reads first two scalar32 words if at least eight bytes.
Only when PCMA property is absent, AIFD:Summary presence plus MDFL:SampleRate presence selects the separate MDFL pair. Summary bytes are not decoded here.
mdvx.damagedPresentPcma: No MDFL fallback for an unreadable/short present PCMA property; initialized zero pair remains.
mdvx.wavdLimit: No explicit WAVD:Summary branch in this helper. This is not a claim about every MDVx reader.

rawRetention.assignment: -[MDVxOMFI addInfoToItem:]0x100064794 calls file-descriptor helper0x100064ae4. Success copies helper rate words at0x100064b08..b10 via setSampleRateNumerator:denominator:.
rawRetention.getter: DB_samplerate0x1000315e8 copies eight bytes via objc_copyStruct. On arm64 returned x0 contains numerator low32 and denominator high32.
rawRetention.precision: Source32-bit pair is retained exactly after per-scalar endian conversion; rational precision is not reduced to an integer frequency. Presentation uses a double later.
rawRetention.default: Helper output is zero-initialized at0x100064b94..98; fresh row initialization does not invent a sample frequency.
rawRetention.headerProjectionLimit: Inspected MDVxMXF addInfoToItem0x1000326b4 copies names/Project/IDs only, not a Sample Rate setter. This limits the ordinary row fallback, not the embedded parser capabilities.

mdvx.display: Non-DNx Sample Rate table/CSV branches divide raw pair as unsigned doubles; denominator zero is substituted with one. Shared label dictionary only, no generic numeric fallback. Table miss is ..., CSV miss is empty.
mdvx.mixedSemantics: Shared storage/column also carries DIDD:FrameSampleSize or DNx bitrate text; not universally audio sampling Hz.
limits: Static bounded ordinary-inventory trace of exact installed hash; not a whole-app raw-browser/parser audit.
No new media/header/database files read or written; no live app/CSV or malformed fixtures exercised.
This receipt does not establish all legacy MDB layouts, pulled-audio interpretation, field-source fallback or Audio frequency vs physical-duration clock policy.
Native Media Composer and actual MDB frequency-source analysis is owned by other agents.

artifacts.role: Previously captured complete disassembly; installed binary hash rechecked unchanged.

method: All six actual MDB and six PMR hashes freshly match prior frame-rate receipts. All six raw-value index hashes freshly match prior duration findings. Inputs are stable during each read.

Every retained identity, catalogue, descriptor-reference, class and audio-frequency/summary property is reconstructed from its raw MDB byte ranges and compared byte-for-byte to its cached index entry before interpretation.

The complete normalized PMR FileMobId selects a unique MOBJ in both SourceMobs and ObjectSpine with PhysicalMedia. PMR MasterMobId independently selects its unique composition catalogue owner. Only the physical FileMob own PhysicalMedia reference selects the descriptor.

ExactEditRate fields use concrete omfi:ExactEditRate type, eight bytes, two signed little-endian 32-bit numerator/denominator values. Both components must be positive. All rates use exact Fraction arithmetic.

An independent stdlib-only chunk decoder reads the selected own WAVD RIFF/WAVE fmt sample-rate integer or selected own AIFD FORM/AIFF-or-AIFC COMM extended80 sample rate. These bytes are embedded in MDB Summary properties. It does not read physical media headers or essence.

Only sample frequency is compared. Embedded frame counts and other fmt/COMM values are contextual and do not alter any Duration policy. Audio edit rates and drop-frame are not inferred from frequency.
Counts are per PMR physical-file row. Descriptor objects are also checked for uniqueness within each MDB. All-property occurrences are separate from own-descriptor counts.
actualDatabases.coverageQualification: Fresh owner/rate logic reads current actual byte ranges, using the established hashed Bento value indexes. This is not a new independent parser of every table-of-contents entry.
limits: This bounded corpus contains only 48000 Hz audio. It cannot distinguish precedence where valid own descriptor sources disagree, nor exercise 44.1/96 kHz or fractional sample frequencies.

All six MDBs are established little-endian legacy layouts. This is not approval of unobserved MDB64, other-endian, unknown descriptor, malformed, missing, duplicate, conflicting, nonpositive or unsupported typed input.
AIFD and WAVD own concrete AudioSamplingRate absence is established on the selected own descriptor objects, not inferred from unrelated-object property occurrence totals.

No OldScanner output, production parser, physical media header or full audio essence is used. No app, repo, media or input files are written. New evidence is written only under this /private/tmp directory.
Frequency evidence does not approve a fallback/priority rule or change Duration, frame-rate, DF or final display formatting policy.

cpp17Qt653.buildingBlocks: Small value records, qint32/quint32/quint64, pinned QtEndian readers after bounds validation. Small specific extended80 decoder. std::gcd for derived fraction reduction; std::ratio is compile-time, not a runtime container.

agreedBellaRule.status: Approved by the user on 20 October 2026; not yet implemented.
agreedBellaRule.missing: Missing, damaged, unsupported or unrepresentable chosen source -> unavailable/blank at MDB stage, keep physical row; no MDFL repair.
agreedBellaRule.retention: Exact supported numeric frequency with compact source/availability context; retain original PCMA pair, WAV integer or necessary AIFF ten-byte value. Bounded exact AIFF support remains implementation work; no sole approximate-double storage.
validation: Qualified own descriptor and exact known property/type.
Complete checked numeric payload; supported Summary signature/chunk bounds and padding.
Positive finite rate; valid nonzero denominator for a fraction.
A header Summary may intentionally omit sound payload. Do not require a full physical audio file inside it.
agreedBellaRule.display: Hz / 1000, e.g. 48 kHz, 44.1 kHz, 96 kHz. Numeric formatting at presentation; uncommon supported frequencies retained rather than dictionary-only labels.
avoid: No guessed 48 kHz default, frequency whitelist, denominator-zero repair or per-row source consistency graph.
No video NTSC rate aliases or project/display frame clock substituted for audio Hz.
No generic whole-Hz rounding of retained frequencies.
laterReview: Exact supported AIFF extended80 representability and other typed/container layouts.
Generic display precision for unusual fractional rates.
General MDB structural damage, conflicts and missing-reference handling.
